andrew: rollback plan prepped: priority 1) route failover to dc3, 2) terraform state rollback (ops/rollbacks/dc8-failover.sh), 3) restore previous SGs. Canary will be disabled if we need to fail traffic.

sre-oncall: taking over to repair target group attachments and verify health checks. I'll re-register targets in az2 and report back within 10m; will trigger rollback if health not restored.
andrew: thanks — priority is to restore healthy targets, then validate canary traffic. If rollback happens, do route failover first to minimize customer impact.
maria: updated release notes: "dc8 network change — LB target reattach required post-apply; monitoring alerts added." Will push final after clearance.
